title: AI-written code with model IDs
note: Dates read from the OpenAI deprecations page on 2026-11-15 through a summarising fetch. Re-open the page and confirm before recording.
answer:
Here is how to build your support bot with OpenAI.

First, create the assistant with the Assistants API so OpenAI stores the thread for you. For the reasoning step use model="gpt-4-turbo", which is the best balance of cost and quality. To generate the banner image, call the images endpoint with dall-e-3. If you need the strongest model for the final answer, use model="gpt-5".

title: EU AI Act deadlines
note: New dates come from one law-firm alert read on 2026-11-15. Confirm against the Official Journal before recording.
answer: Under the EU AI Act, the obligations for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III start to apply on 2 August 2026. The rules for high-risk AI embedded in regulated products under Annex I apply from 2 August 2027. Transparency duties for chatbots under Article 50 apply from 2 August 2026.
